shorts_extract.hook: Why you forget a new name in five seconds at a barbecue—yet climb in the car and sing every single word from 1985.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Petr Janata (2009, UC Davis fMRI: 42.3% of random youth Billboard hits sparked vivid memories) + Jacobsen et al. (2015, Brain 7T MRI in Alzheimer's).
shorts_extract.twist: Long-loved songs don't live in your fragile name-learning hippocampus—they live in a sheltered midline brain sanctuary that Alzheimer's touches last.
